fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-06-05 around 10:15 hrs, it was reported that the complainant learned that a document with altered details had been submitted for a transaction worth Rs. 5,00,000 near Selvapuram Puram Main Street in Vellore. The complaint was lodged by Tamilselvi Devi (9000000452). Dinesh Balan (9000000363), described as an intermediary, was also mentioned in the complaint. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Vasanth Gopal (mobile 9000000245) was named as a possible person of interest. The complainant mentioned physical documents and digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Forged papers reportedly used to process a transaction.
fields.Keywords: forgery, forged document, documents, suspect, digital document, mobile number, morning, associate
